fair_value_reason: Core NTM EPS at Sep-2027 is about $23.65 (0.75 x FY28 $23.0, which is consensus $23.68 less 3%, plus 0.25 x FY29 about $25.9). At 22.5x core that is $532. Add the OpenAI stake of about $27/share (25% of about $1.1T less 25%, over 7.43B diluted shares), for $559. Net debt is not subtracted, because the P/E already carries its interest. This corrects my round-1 figure, which subtracted about $5 twice. Weighted 90/10 with a lease-adjusted FCF-yield cross-check of about $480 (FY28 OCF about $240B, less cash capex of about $145B, less about $15B of new finance leases, at about 2.5%, less $33B net debt, plus the stake), the result is about $551. The agents' mean is $546.8.
supervisor_summary: Round 2 narrowed the fair values from $485-570 to $520-563 (mean $547) without moving the center: the mean P(close >= $518 on 2027-09-30) is 0.551, against 0.550 in round 1. The OpenAI stake (~25%, about $27-28/share net) is not double counted anywhere: every ex-stake multiple is derived from spot less the same stake, and core EPS excludes the OpenAI equity-method result. Net debt including finance leases (~$33B) is the right level in every agent, but agents 3, 4 and 5 wrongly subtract it from P/E values (about -$1 to -3 each), and FCF legs still miss about $21.5B a year of finance-lease capex; the two errors roughly offset. I keep the mean ladder, put fair value at $551 and the thesis break at $400, with low confidence; the next real information is the Q1 FY27 print, likely Oct 28.
